title: RecallRequest
description: Input contract for crystalium.recall(). Recall is universally allowed (Tier × Layer matrix row 'any/recall'). Read-side trust is propagated via D7 min(inputs.tier), not gated here.

scope.description: Scope triple used to filter crystals by project, agent class, and sensitivity.

agent_class_visibility.description: Agent class that may see these results. null = no filter.

sensitivity_tag.description: Sensitivity filter applied by the redactor before results are returned.

query.description: Natural-language probe for hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval.

k.description: Maximum number of results to return.

layers.description: Memory layers to search. Default (absent) = all four layers.
